_comment: STILLGLASS - a mirror lake. A walk-and-wonder world (no goal, no puzzle): a perfectly flat silver lake, pale reeds, grey-green willows and birches, a sky that matches the water. The lake mirrors whatever stands at its north bank (atmosphere.reflections: the reflection layer), and its reflections are slightly wrong (the 'phantoms': tall silver pines and a great oak in the water with nothing on the shore). Eight regions: Sedge Landing (where you arrive), South Shore, West Marsh, Still Water, East Shallows, Grey Orchard, Silverbank and Quiet End. It RE-SKINS ITSELF through its 'art' block (deep-merged over data/art.json): its own turf + litter atlas, silver-green trees (tree entries [x, y, kind]: willow/birch/round/oak), silver water. Its secret is a stone that only exists in the reflection: see the 'secret' block (reveal type 'reflection'). Generated by tools/gen_stillglass_world.py (art: pokepals/tools/gen_stillglass.py) - edit that and re-run, don't hand-tune positions.
intro: A lake so still it keeps a second copy of everything, and does not always copy faithfully. Stand a while at its edge.

props.label: a scratched stone
props.lore: Lines cut into the face of a slab, in a careful hand: 'Whoever walks beside you can see what the water sees. Stand them at the edge, up on the north bank, and be still. Then watch the water, and follow.'

props.label: a little cairn
props.lore: Three stones, stacked by someone who wanted to be remembered by a pile of stones. You add nothing. It is already enough.

props.label: a cairn at the bank
props.lore: The stones at the top of this one are wet, though nothing has splashed them. The bank here drops straight to the water. Stand quietly at its edge with your companion beside you.

props.label: a leaning cairn
props.lore: A cairn that leans toward the water, as if it were trying to see something in it.

props.label: a mooring post
props.lore: A post to tie a boat to. The rope round it has frayed to nothing. There has never been a boat on this lake, and the post knows it.

props.label: another post
props.lore: A second post, standing a long way from the first. Between them the lake does exactly what the sky does.

props.label: a flat stone
props.lore: A flat grey stone. Skip it and it will cross the whole lake without a sound. You do not, because the lake is so quiet.

props.label: a skipping stone
props.lore: A good skipping stone. Whatever you throw in here, the water gives a second one back, a little too neat.

props.label: a bleached log
props.lore: A bleached log on the south shore. Across the water the north bank is exactly as far away as it looks, which is not what you expected.

props.label: a grey boulder
props.lore: A boulder with a patient face. The lake has no reflection of this bank. From here, you notice that, and it feels like being left out of a game.

props.label: a boulder at the marsh
props.lore: Silver-green lichen, and under it the faint print of a hand that rested here.

_secret_comment: This world's one SECRET (docs/home-world-and-secrets-design.md, 'Stillglass'). reveal.type 'reflection': stand the companion at the water's edge by 'start' and, once it settles, its reflection turns into a different animal (picked from 'species_pool', never the one worn) and walks the shore along 'trail' (waterline waypoints, the last is where the stone surfaces), waiting when the player falls behind (ReflectionWalker / ReflectionDirector); at the end the prop rises. The server honours a claim only here, within 'radius' of 'position'.

secret.lore: A smooth grey stone, cold as the lake, and so still it seems to be listening. It is dry. When you look at it, the water below holds its picture a moment longer than it should.

lines.notice: Your companion stops and gazes at the water, head tilted. Something down there has caught its eye.
lines.approach: Your companion pads to the edge and looks down at itself.
lines.gather: The water stirs round your companion's reflection. It is not quite keeping still.
lines.turn: Your companion's reflection is someone else now. It turns its back on you.
lines.set_off: It walks off along the water, and glances back, once, to see whether you will follow.
lines.wait: The reflection stands and waits, up to its ankles in nothing, until you catch up.
lines.lost: The reflection goes back to being only a reflection. It remembers where it got to.
lines.follow: Your companion keeps its eyes on the reflection, and walks the bank beside it. You walk after them both.

reveal.reveal_line: The reflection stops, and the water rings round its feet. On the bank, where it stands, a stone has come up out of the ground. It is dry.

secret.found_line: The stone was only ever in the lake. Your companion's other self showed you where, and then it went back to being a reflection.

keepsake.label: a stone and its reflection, in a dish of water
keepsake.line: A little stone in a dish of still water. The reflection is a touch too bright, and sometimes, if you look at the right moment, it is not quite facing the same way.

portals.label: the way back to the Vale
